## Problem

What are you trying to accomplish? What feels missing or awkward today?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like to see. Mockups, keyboard shortcuts, or example map files are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you discarded them.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps frame the request — links to similar tools, references, etc.
